title: UPPSC GIC Lecturer Mains Online Form 2026
postName: Lecturer (Male/Female) Government Inter College – Mains Exam 2025 (Advt. A-6/E-1/2025)
vacancyDetails: About 1,516–1,518 GIC Lecturer posts; only prelims-qualified candidates can fill Mains online form
qualification: Post Graduate in relevant subject with B.Ed. / as per UPPSC GIC Lecturer rules; must have qualified Prelims 2026
ageLimit: 21 to 40 years as on notification cut-off (relaxations as per UP Govt rules)
applicationFee: As per UPPSC Mains application fee rules for the advertisement
selectionProcess: Prelims (qualified) → Mains Online Form → Mains Written Exam → Interview / DV as applicable
documentsRequired: OTR credentials, prelims details, educational certificates, B.Ed., category certificate, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppsc.up.nic.in
2. Complete / login with OTR
3. Open FILL ONLINE DETAILS for Advt A-6/E-1 Lecturer GIC (Mains)
4. Fill conventional / mains form for qualified subject
5. Submit within 29 July–12 August 2026 window and keep printout
shortDescription: UPPSC GIC Lecturer Mains Online Form 2026 open 29 July–12 August 2026 for prelims-qualified candidates (~1516 posts). Mains exam 30 August 2026.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has started the GIC Lecturer Mains Online Form 2026 for candidates who qualified the Prelims under Advt. A-6/E-1/2025.

Mains form window: 29 July 2026 to 12 August 2026 (approx.). Mains examination is scheduled around 30 August 2026.

Who can apply

  • Only candidates shortlisted in subject-wise Prelims results
  • Must use UPPSC OTR for authentication
  • Fill Lecturer (Male/Female) Government Inter College (Mains) form

Total posts are about 1,516. Always cross-check remaining subject schedules and fee on uppsc.up.nic.in.
